items.t: Kinross Gold (NYSE:KGC) Fits the GARP Screen for Growth at a Reasonable Price
items.sum: Kinross Gold (KGC) fits a Peter Lynch GARP screen with low PEG, strong balance sheet, and cheap valuation, though slower growth and gold-cycle risks remain.

items.t: What Does Kinross Gold (TSX:K) Class Action Mean For Its 2026 To 2028 Guidance?
items.sum: Kinross Gold (TSX:K) faces a newly announced class action lawsuit alleging misleading statements about its 2026 to 2028 production guidance. The complaint claims the company misrepresented its ability to meet projected gold output targets for fiscal years 2026, 2027, and 2028.
